name: Boulderborn Exile

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The exile makes two attacks: one with its Stone Club and one with its Boulder. It can replace one attack with a use of Blinding Shard.

actions.name: Stone Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (7d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Boulder
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (6d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Blinding Shard
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet of the exile must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the exile's next turn.

generation.userConcept: a stone giant exile who speaks only Giant and understands no Common
generation.cite: composition after Fire Giant (CR 9) — the giant ladder continues

Actions.expresses: hurling boulders torn from the earth

other_edition.lore: Quarried from a hold that carved his name off its walls, the exile roams the lowlands hurling stones at strangers who cannot hear his grievance.
